whatChanged: ADVANCED: Writers Guild of America sues to block the Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger, a second legal challenge one day after the 12-state AG lawsuit (psky-wbd-acquisition) (confirmed → confirmed)
NEW: EQT sweetens its takeover pursuit of Australia's Perpetual to A$2.5bn ($1.75bn) after an earlier bid was rejected (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid)
NEW: Anthropic, Blackstone and Hellman & Friedman officially launch Ode, a $1.5bn enterprise AI implementation joint venture (bx-anthropic-ode-partnership)

themes.label: Public-to-private buyout offers on listed companies
themes.note: PE and founder-led buyouts keep pulling listed names private: Castlelake's easyJet take-private (ezj-castlelake-takeover) was topped by a rival Apollo bid (ezj-apollo-takeover), Steel Partners is bidding $16.75/share for InMode (inmd-steel-partners-buyout), EQT/Advent/KKR are circling Qiagen (qgen-pe-consortium-takeover-interest), Vista Equity Partners and Quinti Capital have approached Criteo (crto-vista-quinti-takeover-interest), Perfect Corp.'s founder is taking the company private outright (perf-projectny-going-private), and EQT has now sweetened its own pursuit of Australia's Perpetual (ppt-eqt-takeover-bid).

themes.label: UK-listed franchises broken up or taken private
themes.note: EasyJet's take-private is now a two-bidder contest between Castlelake (ezj-castlelake-takeover) and Apollo (ezj-apollo-takeover), ITV sold its broadcast arm to Comcast's Sky (itv-sky-me-sale), and Segro's board is fending off Prologis's unsolicited approach (pld-sgro-takeover-bid) — UK-listed names remain a magnet for control-changing bids.

themes.label: Semiconductor deals stay active
themes.note: Chip-sector partnerships and consolidation stay live: the Intel-Apple foundry partnership (intc-aapl-partnership), the rumored AMD bid for Lattice (amd-xlnx-followup-acquisition), and Apple's $30bn+ US chipmaking commitment to Broadcom (aapl-avgo-chipmaking-partnership).

themes.label: Defense primes racing for undersea/anti-submarine-warfare tech
themes.note: Defense primes keep building out undersea-warfare capability: Thales's control deal for mine-clearing drone maker Exail (ho-exail-acquisition), Lockheed's $3.45bn purchase of sonar specialist Ultra Maritime (lmt-ultra-maritime-acquisition), and Fincantieri bundling four acquisitions into an underwater-tech champion (fct-underwater-champion-acquisitions).

themes.label: Signed M&A deals hitting regulatory or legal roadblocks
themes.note: Signed deals investors thought were settled keep drawing legal fire: the already-signed, DOJ-cleared Paramount Skydance-Warner Bros. Discovery merger now faces two separate lawsuits, from a 12-state AG coalition and from the Writers Guild of America (psky-wbd-acquisition), while an Israeli court has frozen InMode's board from deciding between competing buyout bids (inmd-steel-partners-buyout).
